# XML renderer Java expression observations

These fixtures preserve 38 fixed-URI Pkl programs evaluated with power assertions enabled and disabled, for 76 Java observations. Each mode retains the complete status, expression, stdout, stderr and exception-class fields, including UTF-8 and big-endian UTF-16 channels. The class fields are Java provenance, not Rust exception-class assertions.

The source authority is the pinned Pkl 0.32.0 Java capture `stage141-xml-oracle-01`, its structural readback and independent admission. These fixtures are bounded reference evidence, not a claim of Rust parity or full XML compatibility. The 17 original upstream CLI contracts are separate cases and are not counted here.
